description: Maya at desk holds her phone toward camera, screen dark (real screen composited in edit)
Maya leans in, raises an eyebrow, holds up one finger
Maya mimes a slow thumb-scroll in the air, then lets her hand drop
Maya draws a sharp cliff shape in the air with one hand, following it with her eyes
Maya counts the three fixes on her fingers, energy lifting
Maya settles back, half-smile, glances at the plant, back to lens
